name: 62288 · Steeleville, IL
findings: ZIP 62288 (Steeleville) has 13 nonprofit organizations. 7 of them (54%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 6 organizations.
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 62288 (Steeleville) has more organizations offering opportunities per resident.
43% of the organizations offering opportunities have no identified type, so the breakdown by type is partial.
